blocks.text: DeepSeek V4 Pro is a open-source language model from DeepSeek, released on Apr 24, 2026.
At $0.435 input and $0.87 output per million tokens, it ranks #9 of 40 for input price, placing it mid-range on input cost.
Its context window of 1M tokens ranks #28 of 41 for context depth in this dataset.
It targets coding, reasoning, budget workloads.
Throughput is measured at 72 tokens per second (ranked #17 of 23 for throughput).
1.6T total params / 49B active MoE; supports Thinking and Non-Thinking modes; OpenAI + Anthropic API compatible.
